# PASS-required tests with Linux-conformant semantics.
testcases/kernel/syscalls/close/close01.c verified close(2) for file/pipe/socket descriptors
testcases/kernel/syscalls/close/close02.c verified close(2) EBADF on invalid fd
testcases/kernel/syscalls/clone/clone08.c verified CLONE_PARENT, CLONE_CHILD_SETTID, CLONE_PARENT_SETTID, and CLONE_THREAD clear_child_tid/futex orchestration within the supported clone subset
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_create1/epoll_create1_01.c verified epoll_create1 CLOEXEC behavior
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_create1/epoll_create1_02.c verified epoll_create1 EINVAL on invalid flags
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_wait/epoll_wait07.c verified EPOLLONESHOT readiness suppression with epoll_create1-backed LTP coverage
testcases/kernel/syscalls/close_range/close_range02.c verified close_range(2) range closing, invalid range/flags, large no-op range, CLOEXEC marking, and UNSHARE child isolation within the implemented fd-table model
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup/dup01.c verified dup(2) creates an fd referring to the same file object
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup/dup02.c verified dup(2) EBADF for invalid oldfd values

testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup/dup04.c verified dup(2) works for both ends of an unnamed pipe
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup/dup06.c verified dup(2) duplicates exactly the available fd-table slots up to the open-file limit
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup/dup07.c verified dup(2) preserves the underlying file access mode

testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup202.c verified libc dup2 lowering preserves file mode across replacement fds
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup203.c verified libc dup2 lowering replaces open/closed fds, clears FD_CLOEXEC, and reads from the duplicated file
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup204.c verified libc dup2 lowering preserves pipe inode identity
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup205.c verified libc dup2 lowering stops at the open-file limit with a Linux-accepted errno
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup206.c verified libc dup2 lowering with oldfd == newfd returns the unchanged fd
testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup2/dup207.c verified libc dup2 lowering shares the open-file-description offset

testcases/kernel/syscalls/dup3/dup3_02.c verified dup3(2) EINVAL for oldfd == newfd and invalid flags
